    Bridging Human Vision & Automation

    Where Human Vision Meets Intelligent Automation

    At MULTIPLE UNIVERSE (MultiPU), we bridge the gap between traditional operations and futuristic digital systems. We specialize in high-performance web applications, automated workflow engines, and custom portals for educational institutions, corporate enterprises and growing businesses.

    Technology should enhance human expertise, not replace it. We turn repetitive manual processes — from administrative documentation and student records to client onboarding — into dynamic, self-sustaining digital pipelines.

    Our Vision: to unify digital potential by turning complex workflows into simple, elegant, automated solutions.
    Our Expertise: School & Enterprise Portals, Synaptic Workflow Automation, Secured Client Dashboards and AI-Driven Data Analytics.

    TMWS · Staff System

    The Multiverse Working System — Global Performance Ecosystem

    One place where the work people do, the rank they earn, the pay they receive and the safety nets around them are measured by the same fair rules.

    Every staff member who works with the company goes through TMWS: you register, learn the rules, sign the agreement with your own device biometric, and then your attendance, rank and pay are recorded against that verified identity. Your record is how the company, and anyone you show your QR code to, can confirm that you are real, registered and in good standing.

    OPEN TMWS

    Biometric steps (fingerprint or face unlock, GPS) need the full page, so use Open TMWS on your phone for registration and attendance.

    Why it exists

    In most workplaces attendance sits in one register, pay in another, promotions in someone’s memory and promises in a drawer. Workers cannot see how effort becomes reward, and managers cannot easily prove they were fair. TMWS puts effort, reward, accountability and protection on one page, so everyone can read the rules and see how they apply to them.

    Our goal is a workplace where fairness is visible: the same rules for every sector, from the worldwide level down to the frontline, and a verified record behind every person.

    The staff journey

    Eight steps from sign-up to your first pay. Each step adds to your verified TMWS record.

    Your incentives

    Rules and regulation

    Escalation when targets are missed

    Counted over the last 30 days. Six steps, so the path is always clear.

    Verification: what is stored, when and where

    Staff data is saved to TMWS as each step is completed. Until the TMWS server is connected, the live page runs in demo mode and keeps everything on the device only. Do not use demo mode for real pay or legal records.

    StepData stored in the TMWS recordVerified by
    Sign inGoogle emailGoogle sign-in
    RegisterName, profession, organization email, branch, staff ID (TM######), passkey credential IDDevice biometric; one-time code to the organization email
    Interview resultSector category and delegation level (1 to 10)HR
    AgreementAgreement version, five accepted clauses, typed name, time, SHA-256 record hashBiometric signature, then e-notary anchoring
    Stamped letterPhoto of the signed and stamped letter, scan timeAdmin review; QR on the letter must match the record
    AttendanceDate, session, branch, sign-in and sign-out time, GPS result (Approved or Pending)Biometric plus GPS within 150 m of the branch
    Rank and payVerified days, rank, stars, cycle credits, targets missed, loans, housing tierCycle job on the server (28-day cycle, paid on day 28)

    Privacy: your fingerprint or face never leaves your device; TMWS keeps only the credential ID and a signed hash. The stamped-letter photo goes to private storage seen only by authorised reviewers. Speak up reports are anonymous and are not tied to your identity.

    Verify a staff record

    Scan the QR code on a staff agreement letter, or type the record code or serial printed on it.

    Quick rank and pay check

    Every 30 verified present days earns one rank (up to 600). The bonus is ₦5,000 per rank, rising 30% every 20 ranks.

    For managers and administrators

    • Compare the five sector ladders (Education, Works and Tech, Admin and HR, Security and Safety, Welfare and Support) in Hierarchy. The Education ladder is the reference; the other four are drafts to edit before use.
    • Check a staff member’s serial or QR in Registry before granting access or benefits.
    • Set each branch’s GPS location in TMWS Settings so attendance can be approved automatically.
    • Use the TMWS template in the Template Library to launch the same system for another organization: edit config.js (brand, branches, session windows, geofence, limits, admin email) and replace the logo.
